meta.title: Support at MepMail — email, docs, changelog
meta.description: How to get help with MepMail: email support, the documentation, the changelog, and answers to the questions we get most — migration, domains, plan limits, billing and spam folders.

hero.title: Support at MepMail
hero.lead: MepMail is founder-operated: the people who build it answer the email. Pick the channel that fits — most questions are already answered in the docs.
hero.note: For account questions, contact email support. Never share passwords, API keys or access codes.

channels.body: Choose the channel that fits your question.

items.body: There is no public status page yet, so there is no URL to link to. When it exists, this card will point at it.
bullets: Until then, material service changes reach you by email.

items.a: Sending serves application messages, sign-ups and campaigns, with a dashboard, HTTP API, templates, contacts, broadcasts, webhooks and metrics.
Visit mepmail.dev, select the correct organization, add a domain you control and complete DNS verification. Then create a key in API Keys with the permissions you need.

items.q: Does adding my domain create an inbox?
items.a: Verification prepares your domain for Sending. Mailboxes are a separate service: registering a mailbox does not automatically change MX or enable receiving. Use the records shown in the dashboard for that domain.

Yes, through the Send API or the published MCP, within the connection's permissions. Copy the endpoint from Settings → MCP. With the mail permissions, the same MCP also reads and drafts in the Mail inboxes you tick when you connect it, asking your approval before each send; an agent key on the Mail MCP works too.

items.q: Can I receive email or import Gmail/Hotmail?
items.a: Yes, with MepMail Mail: email inboxes on your domain for people and AI agents. On its own it costs US$ 12.90/month with 3 mailboxes (US$ 3.90 per extra one), sharing 10 GiB and 2,000 outbound deliveries a month, with up to 3 domains and 7 days free, or from US$ 5.90 with a paid Send plan; each mailbox needs a verified domain with receiving turned on. We do not offer IMAP or Gmail/Hotmail/MBOX/PST import yet, and Google sign-in does not sync a Gmail inbox.

items.q: What are the prices and limits?
items.a: Send and Mail prices are on the pricing page. Send and Mail have separate licences and quotas, and checkout shows the final price for your organization.

items.q: Sending failed or my email has not arrived. What should I check?
items.a: Check domain verification, key permissions, quotas, suppressions and sending status in the logs. Acceptance or queuing does not prove delivery to the recipient inbox. For diagnosis, provide the time, HTTP status and request or message ID; do not share passwords or keys.

items.q: How do I migrate from Resend?
items.a: Point the official Resend SDKs at MepMail's base URL, swap the API key, and move your domains and contacts. The free account can be migrated with npx @mepmail/cli migrate --from resend. The per-language guide walks through each SDK.

items.q: How do I report abuse or spam?
items.a: Email suporte@mepmail.dev with the message id or the headers. We act on abuse reports, and sending that generates complaints can be paused or the account suspended.

close.title: Nothing here answered it?
close.body: Send the account email and what you expected to happen — that is usually enough to get a concrete answer.
